text:
Riley (People Ops): Quick thread to capture Qs from today's all-hands about reviews, leveling, and comp. Posting short answers + next steps.

Zoe: Timeline check  when do managers send notices?

Riley (People Ops): Managers will notify between May 10-17. If you don't get anything by May 18, ping people-ops and we'll follow up.

Marcus (Eng Manager): For part-time ICs, is the bar prorated or the same? We have some fractional FTE folks.

Anya (Talent Partner): Level expectations remain role-level, not FTE-adjusted. Managers should document scope and impact relative to role. Compensation and pro-ration for base/refreshes will follow FTE percentage.

Sam: What about vesting schedule changes on promotion? Any automatic reset?

Theo (Finance): No automatic reset. Promotions do not restart vesting. Equity refreshes are handled by the grant policy; promos may trigger a refresh at next grant window (pro-rated if before cutoff).

Zoe: If someone is relocating and changes legal entity, does that affect their review or comp timeline?

Riley (People Ops): Transfers across legal entities can affect payroll timing. Notify international-hr and people-ops early; we'll coordinate and may accept late packets if timing conflicts with payroll/legal windows.

Marcus (Eng Manager): Any new guidance on writing packets? My team wants more prescriptive examples.

Anya (Talent Partner): We'll post three short sample packets (IC-focused) by EOD Monday: clear, borderline, and not-ready, each with key evidence bullets managers can reuse.

Sam: Appeals? Short reminder of the process.

Riley (People Ops): Appeals open for 14 days after notice. Send to appeals@redwood.com with your manager's packet and rationale. People Ops triages and the cross-functional panel reviews.

people-ops-bot: Links: reviews toolkit: https://redwood.internal/hr/reviews-toolkit and appeals: appeals@redwood.com.

Riley (People Ops): Thanks all  DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com for private follow-ups; we'll update this thread when samples and FAQs are live.
